name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza deaths 17 Nov; Iran strikes on Bahrain
summary: Israeli fire killed four in Gaza on 17 Nov, medics said; Iran fired drones at Bahrain on 13, 15 and 16 Nov
state: Israeli fire killed four people in Gaza, including a six-year-old boy, on 17 Nov, according to medics (Reuters via US News). Bahrain issued its first threat alerts since September on 15 Nov as Iran's Guards said they attacked a US base (Khaleej Times), after a 13 Nov drone attack that US Central Command confirmed (Reuters via Jerusalem Post). Repeated cross-border strikes in the Gulf alongside continuing deaths in Gaza keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon and the Gulf states, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation and cross-border strikes = Alert

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
